name: Deffkoptas
_source_note: Stats, weapons, keywords, composition and points match this datasheet on Wahapedia's 11th edition Orks page, read 2026-10-13. Ability text in data/abilities.json is a summary.
_costing_note: Printed as: 1st to 2nd unit 85 pts for 3 models / 170 pts for 6 models; 3rd+ unit 95 pts for 3 models / 180 pts for 6 models.
_composition_note: Printed as: 3-6 Deffkopta models. Keyed by unit size, then by model; the model mix on the card, and how many of each weapon the unit starts with, follow from it.
_loadout: Every model is equipped with: 1 Choppa; 1 Rokkit Launcha; 1 Slugga; 1 Spinnin’ Blades.
_weapons_note: carriedBy names the model(s) that start with a weapon — { model: n } when one carries several — so its count follows the unit's size. A weapon with no carriedBy is only ever taken through a wargear option.

ranged.name: Rokkit Launcha - Blasta
ranged.weaponGroupLabel: Before selecting targets with this weapon, select one of its profiles to make attacks with.

_wargearOptions_note: Printed as: For every 3 models in this unit, 1 model can have their Rokkit Launcha replaced with 1 Kustom Mega-blasta.
